## 2. Licensing, Safety and Chauffeur Standards

- Vehicle Permits: Commercial All-India Tourist Permit (AITP), Yellow Board registration, comprehensive commercial passenger insurance
- Driver Verification: 100% Police Verification Certificate (PVC), zero criminal record guarantee
- Chauffeur Qualifications: Minimum 5+ years commercial highway experience; certified for Western Ghats / Nilgiri hairpin bend driving (Ooty, Kodaikanal, Yercaud, Valparai, Kolli Hills, Munnar)
- Chauffeur Code: Non-smoking, non-drinking, professionally uniformed, multi-lingual (Tamil, English, basic Hindi/Telugu/Kannada)
- Fleet Maintenance: Vehicles sanitized pre-trip, continuous GPS tracking, speed governor compliance, spare tire and emergency toolkit verified every trip
- Temple Tour Drivers: Satvik (vegetarian, non-alcoholic, non-smoking) chauffeurs only for pilgrimage routes
- Female Employee Safety: GPS and SOS protocols for all corporate employee shift services

## 10. Billing Rules, Transparency and Policy

1. Per-KM Computation: Kilometres calculated garage-to-garage from Medavakkam, Chennai, or from agreed pickup. Calibrated odometer reading verified by passenger at start and end.
2. Minimum Daily Distance: Standard 250 km per calendar day for Sedan, Ertiga, Innova. 300 km per calendar day for Innova Crysta, Tempo Traveller, Force Urbania. If you travel less, the minimum applies.
3. Driver Batta (Allowance): Fixed daily fee per calendar day (midnight-to-midnight cycle) covering chauffeur food and lodging. Included in all local hourly packages. Billed separately for open outstation per-km trips.
4. Tolls and Parking: FASTag highway toll charges and temple/airport parking tickets billed at actual government slip amounts, zero markup.
5. Interstate State Entry Permits: When crossing Tamil Nadu borders into Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Pondicherry, or Kerala, government border permit taxes apply at actuals.
6. No Hidden Surge: Fixed prices irrespective of rain, festivals, peak hours, or traffic.
7. GST Invoicing: Full GST-compliant tax invoices available for all corporate trips with GSTIN input tax credit eligibility.
8. Cancellation Policy: Zero cancellation fee for bookings cancelled 4+ hours before scheduled pickup.
9. One-Way Trips: One-way outstation drop service available to Bangalore, Pondicherry, Tirupati, Vellore, Trichy, Madurai at fixed rates.

## 12. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q: Do you offer one-way drop taxi from Chennai to other cities?
A: Yes. One-way drop taxi from Chennai to Bangalore, Pondicherry, Tirupati, Vellore, Trichy, Madurai, Salem, Coimbatore, and Yercaud. You only pay for the one-way distance, no return charges.

Q: How is outstation fare calculated? Are there hidden fees?
A: Outstation fares are calculated based on actual kilometres with a minimum of 250 km per day (300 km for Tempo Traveller). Pricing is 100% transparent, zero hidden fees. Night driving surcharges and driver batta are clearly stated before booking confirmation.

Q: Are driver batta, tolls, and interstate permits included?
A: Driver batta is included in all local hourly packages, and in temple tour fixed packages. For open per-km outstation trips, batta is a separate per-day charge. FASTag tolls, parking fees, and interstate permits (e.g., AP, Karnataka, Kerala) are billed at actuals with government receipts.

Q: What vehicles are available for temple tours and family trips?
A: Swift Dzire and Toyota Etios (4 pax), Maruti Ertiga (6 pax), Innova and Innova Crysta (6 to 7 pax), Tempo Travellers (12 to 26 pax), Force Urbania (10 to 16 pax).

Q: Do you provide 24/7 airport pickup at Chennai Airport (MAA)?
A: Yes. Round-the-clock airport transfers for Domestic (T1) and International (T2/T4) terminals. Driver tracks your flight in real-time to adjust for delays. Name placard greeting at arrivals.

Q: Can I hire an acting driver for my own personal car?
A: Yes. Police-verified chauffeurs for manual and automatic cars within Chennai (4 hrs: 600 INR, 8 hrs: 900 INR), or for outstation trips in your vehicle (600 to 1000 INR per day based on vehicle type).

Q: Is night travel safe?
A: Yes. All drivers undergo police background verification (PVC), have 5+ years highway experience, and follow strict non-alcoholic and fatigue-management safety protocols.

Q: What is the cancellation policy?
A: Zero cancellation fee for bookings cancelled 4+ hours before scheduled pickup.

Q: Can I customize a temple tour itinerary midway?
A: Yes. All pilgrimage packages (Tirupati, Navagraha, Thiruvannamalai, Rameswaram) are flexible. You can request additional temple stops or dining breaks along the route.

Q: How far in advance should I book?
A: For local city trips and airport transfers, 2 to 4 hours advance notice is sufficient. For weekend temple tours, outstation trips, and festival periods (Girivalam, Pongal, Diwali), book 24 to 48 hours ahead.

Q: What is the minimum billing for a local trip?
A: The 5hr/50km local package is the minimum for city duty. For outstation, the minimum is 250 km per day (300 km per day for larger vehicles).

Q: Do you provide GST invoices?
A: Yes. Full GSTIN (33COVPM0531D1Z4) tax invoices for all trips, enabling corporate input tax credit claims and company reimbursements.
